title: TriAgent: code, instances and runs for the SOC4IA 2026 paper "One Run Is Not Evidence"
description: Code, instances and all runs behind the SOC4IA 2026 position paper "One Run Is Not Evidence: Rethinking the Evaluation of Multi-Agent LLM Architectures": the TriAgent implementation (Knowledge, Reasoning and Execution agents on LangGraph), the rule store, 100 instances of five crop-disease processes with their ground truth, the scoring and analysis scripts (per-seed accuracy, ICC(1), effective sample size, convergence, interquartile mean), and about 6,000 runs: Full vs No-Knowledge under 20 seeds on Gemma-4-26B-A4B and 5 on Qwen3.8-27B, and a single-call baseline repeated five times at temperature 0.
